features.title: Cache Bypassing
features.description: The global refresh button now actively passes a refresh=true flag to bypass local caching across the Dashboard, Inbox, and Thread Viewer.

features.title: Refresh Visual Feedback
features.description: Thread viewer now correctly displays skeleton loaders during an active manual refresh.

features.title: Backend Rate Limiter
features.description: Moved rate limiting for manual refreshes from the frontend to a dedicated refreshRateLimiter middleware in the backend (max 10 requests per minute).

features.title: Marketing UI Redesign
features.description: Complete ground-up redesign of the Privacy, Terms, and FAQ pages with glassmorphic cards and interactive layouts.

features.title: Fluid Typography
features.description: Implemented modern viewport-relative typography scaling across all marketing pages for perfect responsiveness on every device.

features.title: Changelog Widget
features.description: Added a premium floating action widget and split-pane version history modal for tracking platform updates.

features.title: Manual & AI Reply Composers
features.description: A dynamic composer inside the thread viewer allowing users to edit AI drafts, regenerate them, or write completely manual replies.

features.title: Instant Background Prefetching
features.description: Added a ThreadCacheProvider that silently fetches full thread details in the background upon initial inbox load, resulting in 0ms load times when clicking emails.

features.title: Infinite Scrolling
features.description: Implemented Intersection Observer-based infinite pagination for all list views (Inbox, Spam, Trash, Drafts).

features.title: Dynamic Contextual UI
features.description: The Thread Viewer now dynamically displays 'Not Spam' or 'Restore' buttons if a thread is opened from Spam or Trash, and disables replying when in Trash.

features.title: Loading Animations
features.description: Real-time Socket.IO feedback indicating when background Gmail synchronization is active and when AI Analysis is processing.

features.title: Resilient AI Pipeline
features.description: Implemented graceful failure handling and status management for AI summaries, preventing UI glitches on FAILED or SKIPPED states.

features.title: Inbox UI Overhaul
features.description: Complete redesign of the Inbox interface featuring color-coded avatars, unread indicators, stagger animations, and skeleton loaders.

features.title: Thread Viewer
features.description: Advanced email viewer with thread collapsing, HTML body isolation (safe dark mode), and proper overflow handling.

features.title: Live Dashboard
features.description: Dynamic stats grid pulling realtime sync status and recent conversations.

features.title: Auth UI
features.description: Integrated AuthProvider and ProtectedRoute components in Next.js.

features.title: Landing Page Evolution
features.description: Upgraded the root page to feature a hero section with a Continue with Google flow and authenticated user state tracking.

features.title: Application Skeleton
features.description: Complete Next.js 15 App Router foundation.

features.title: Global Layout
features.description: Implemented responsive MainLayout, Sidebar, and Header components.

features.title: Theming & Aesthetics
features.description: Implemented Dark/Light mode using next-themes and a custom Tailwind v4 theme.

features.title: AI Draft Generation
features.description: Integrated automatic backend generation of AI email replies using Groq when needsReply is true. The AI uses full chronological thread context.

features.title: Gmail Send Integration
features.description: Sending replies through MailBot natively uses the Gmail API, automatically marks spam as inbox upon reply, and supports sending without an AI draft.

features.title: Rate Limit Splitting
features.description: Separated strict authentication rate limits (20 req / 15m) from broader API rate limits (300 req / 1m).

features.title: AI Eligibility Tweaks
features.description: Adjusted AI prompts to explicitly skip newsletters, system alerts, and thank you notes from draft generation.

features.title: AI Eligibility Engine
features.description: Advanced filtering to prevent Groq API token burns on historical imports and self-sent messages.

features.title: Smart Message Counts
features.description: Refactored Prisma count logic in upsertThreadAndEmails to actively filter out soft-deleted and trashed emails.

features.title: Hard Delete Synchronization
features.description: Upgraded the markMessagesAsDeleted hook to instantly recalculate and sync parent thread counts when messages are permanently deleted via Webhook.

features.title: Gmail Sync Engine
features.description: Robust incremental synchronization via Gmail History API, handling pagination, batching, and history expiration fallbacks.

features.title: Performance
features.description: Optimized backend sync to reduce API calls and frontend polling logic for real-time sync progress updates.

features.title: OAuth Integration
features.description: Complete Google OAuth 2.0 flow integrated on the backend.

features.title: Server-Side Sessions
features.description: Secure HTTP-only sessions via express-session and connect-pg-simple.

features.title: Token Encryption
features.description: AES-256-GCM encryption for storing OAuth tokens in PostgreSQL.

features.title: Express Skeleton
features.description: Production-ready REST API architecture with separation of concerns.

features.title: Database
features.description: Singleton Prisma client instance wrapper to prevent connection exhaustion.

features.title: Schema Refinement
features.description: Updated AiProvider enum to include GROQ and set UserSetting default to Groq.

features.title: Database Architecture
features.description: Complete Prisma schema for a production AI email platform.

features.title: Core Email Models
features.description: Email, EmailThread, EmailAccountConnection optimized for Gmail/Outlook integrations.
